intro.fr: La Definitive Edition de Divinity: Original Sin 2 a sa version du mod Enemy Randomization depuis 2018.
intro.en: The Definitive Edition of Divinity: Original Sin 2 has had its version of the Enemy Randomization mod since 2018.

text.fr: Larian Studios publie en 2018 la Definitive Edition de Divinity: Original Sin II, sorti en 2017.
text.en: Larian Studios releases the Definitive Edition of Divinity: Original Sin II in 2018, the game having come out in 2017.

text.fr: Le 1er septembre 2018, Baardvaark publie sur Nexus Mods la version Definitive Edition de son mod : ennemis renforcés au hasard, avec copie d'ennemis en option. Il est aussi sur le Steam Workshop.
text.en: On September 1, 2018, Baardvaark posts the Definitive Edition version of their mod on Nexus Mods: enemies get random buffs, with optional enemy copying. It is also on the Steam Workshop.
